title: Keeping workshop travel and attendance records separate
titleZh: 分開登記工作坊差旅與出席紀錄
passage:
To: Apprenticeship coordinators
Subject: Travel records for the off-site workshop

A trip to the workshop counts as work time when a coordinator has asked the apprentice to attend in person. Travel reimbursement is limited to those same trips, and a receipt is required for each amount claimed. The payroll clerk will still log the work time if the bus company cannot supply a receipt. Some receipts combine several fares. When a single ticket covers two apprentices, use the coordinator’s individual attendance requests to establish each person’s eligibility. [135] _____ The receipt can document the split, but cannot make an optional journey eligible.

Some apprentices have a receipt that lists only the return fare. The travel clerk can reimburse that amount now. If the outbound receipt turns up later, add it to the same reimbursement file rather than opening another one. [136] _____ This keeps two receipts for a single trip from being mistaken for two trips.

Ava booked a seat on the morning bus after receiving an invitation that let her choose either attendance mode. The next day the coordinator asked her to present a physical sample, so she needed to come in. She took the same bus she had already booked. Record the travel time on the basis of [137] _____. Whether the booking can be refunded does not affect that decision.

On the attendance sheet, show how each apprentice actually took part. An apprentice who missed the opening talk on the bus may watch it online the following day. Mark that talk as completed only once the apprentice has viewed the recording, [138] _____ the rest of the in-person attendance as originally entered.
passageZh:
收件人：學徒訓練協調員
主旨：在外部場地舉辦的工作坊的差旅紀錄

如果協調員要求學徒到現場，前往工作坊的車程就算工作時間。只有同樣符合這項條件的差旅才可報銷，並且每一筆申報金額都須有收據。如果客運公司無法開收據，薪資人員仍會登記工作時間。有些收據把數筆車資列在一起。如果同一張車票涵蓋兩名學徒，就依協調員對每人的出席要求判斷是否符合資格。[135] _____ 收據可以證明金額如何拆分，但無法讓自行選擇前往的行程變成符合資格。

有些學徒的收據只列回程車資。差旅人員現在就可報銷這一筆。如果後來找到去程收據，請附在同一份報銷檔，不要重新開檔。[136] _____ 這樣做可避免同一趟差旅的兩張收據被誤認成兩趟。

艾娃收到一封可自行選擇出席方式的邀請後，訂了早班客運。隔天，協調員請她展示實體樣品，因此她必須到場。她搭了原本訂好的那班車。請根據 [137] _____ 登記車程時間。訂票能否退款不影響這項判斷。

出席單請記錄每位學徒實際參與的方式。在車上而錯過開場演講的學徒，可於隔天上線補看。只有補看錄影後，才把該場演講標示為完成，[138] _____ 其餘現場出席紀錄的原始內容。
reviewPassage:
To: Apprenticeship coordinators
Subject: Travel records for the off-site workshop

A trip to the workshop counts as work time when a coordinator has asked the apprentice to attend in person. Travel reimbursement is limited to those same trips, and a receipt is required for each amount claimed. The payroll clerk will still log the work time if the bus company cannot supply a receipt. Some receipts combine several fares. When a single ticket covers two apprentices, use the coordinator’s individual attendance requests to establish each person’s eligibility. Claim only the share of each apprentice required to attend in person, even if the whole fare appears on the receipt. The receipt can document the split, but cannot make an optional journey eligible.

Some apprentices have a receipt that lists only the return fare. The travel clerk can reimburse that amount now. If the outbound receipt turns up later, add it to the same reimbursement file rather than opening another one. Use the original journey reference on any supplemental receipt. This keeps two receipts for a single trip from being mistaken for two trips.

Ava booked a seat on the morning bus after receiving an invitation that let her choose either attendance mode. The next day the coordinator asked her to present a physical sample, so she needed to come in. She took the same bus she had already booked. Record the travel time on the basis of the coordinator’s request, made before she travelled, that she attend in person. Whether the booking can be refunded does not affect that decision.

On the attendance sheet, show how each apprentice actually took part. An apprentice who missed the opening talk on the bus may watch it online the following day. Mark that talk as completed only once the apprentice has viewed the recording, leaving the rest of the in-person attendance as originally entered.
reviewPassageZh:
收件人：學徒訓練協調員
主旨：在外部場地舉辦的工作坊的差旅紀錄

如果協調員要求學徒到現場，前往工作坊的車程就算工作時間。只有同樣符合這項條件的差旅才可報銷，並且每一筆申報金額都須有收據。如果客運公司無法開收據，薪資人員仍會登記工作時間。有些收據把數筆車資列在一起。如果同一張車票涵蓋兩名學徒，就依協調員對每人的出席要求判斷是否符合資格。即使收據列的是全部車資，也只申報每位被要求親自出席者應分攤的金額。收據可以證明金額如何拆分，但無法讓自行選擇前往的行程變成符合資格。

有些學徒的收據只列回程車資。差旅人員現在就可報銷這一筆。如果後來找到去程收據，請附在同一份報銷檔，不要重新開檔。補交收據時沿用原本的差旅編號。這樣做可避免同一趟差旅的兩張收據被誤認成兩趟。

艾娃收到一封可自行選擇出席方式的邀請後，訂了早班客運。隔天，協調員請她展示實體樣品，因此她必須到場。她搭了原本訂好的那班車。請根據協調員在她搭車前要求她到場出席的通知登記車程時間。訂票能否退款不影響這項判斷。

出席單請記錄每位學徒實際參與的方式。在車上而錯過開場演講的學徒，可於隔天上線補看。只有補看錄影後，才把該場演講標示為完成，同時保留其餘現場出席紀錄的原始內容。
